crossRefs.note: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.
Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.
But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul, and dragged…
About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.
But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—
Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The…
So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

people.name: Barabbas
people.line: A notorious prisoner released instead of Jesus.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
translations.bsb: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus put to death.
translations.kjv: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
translations.asv: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes that they should ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
